entity_types: NGO local/foreign (NGO Act No. 16 of 2009); trust (Trusts Restriction Act 1970, Ministry of Lands); society (Societies Act 1930)
cost_time: Fee ZMW 1,008 (~USD 45) for international NGO, ZMW 216 annual; police clearance/fingerprints small extras; certificate within ~3 months (unpublished official SLA); trusts ~4 months

entity_types: NGO, local or foreign (NGO Act 1997 / No.6 of 2001, amended 2022); incorporated company (Companies Act); trust (Trustee Act 1956)
cost_time: NGORA fee MK 250,000 (~USD 145) + CONGOMA incorporation (~USD 30); 2-8 weeks; no published official time. Requires >=2 Malawian-citizen directors/trustees.

entity_types: Associations (Lei 8/91); Foundations (Lei 16/2018); Foreign NGO authorization (Decreto 55/98 via Ministry of Foreign Affairs); 2022 NGO law proposal (Lei OSFL) still pending
cost_time: Registry fees low (tens of MZN); notary/agent ~USD 200-1,500 total; association weeks-3 months; foreign NGO MFA authorization 2-6 months (unpublished); local legal rep required

entity_types: Associação registada (civil association, Lei 9/10, legal personality via registry); ONG nacional (Lei 2/26 art. 5); ONG estrangeira registered in Angola with mandatory prior habilitação (Lei 2/26 arts. 4-6)
cost_time: Official fee unpublished; est. USD 300-1,500 total (counsel, notary, translations); prior habilitação authorization + registry; 3-12 months; foreigners need a local representative/office

entity_types: Society (Societies Act 2022); company limited by guarantee (Companies Act); trust (deed of trust); body established by Act of Parliament
cost_time: USD ~20-60 (society, P500-1,500) to ~190 (CLG, P4,600); no official processing time (unpublished), plan 4-8 weeks; foreigners may register but 2/3 of society office-bearers must reside in Botswana

entity_types: Non-profit company (Sec. 21 "company not for gain", Companies Act 28 of 2004, BIPA); registered society (Societies Act); trust by deed (Deeds Registries Act 2015); NamRA welfare-organisation tax status
cost_time: BIPA statutory fees ~N$500-1,000 (~USD 35-70) plus Namibian notary for MOI; local office + registered agent required, no local-director rule, foreigners OK; 2-4 weeks to incorporate

entity_types: PVO (Private Voluntary Organisations Act [Ch 17:05], 2005, amended 2025; local & international PVOs); trust (Law of Declaration of Trust Act [Ch 65:03]); unincorporated common-law association
cost_time: Reg fee US$150 local / US$250 international; legal/agent extra (US$100-500); processing time unpublished, commonly 1-4 months; foreign PVOs need a Zimbabwean local representative

entity_types: NPO as association not for gain (Companies Act No. 8 of 2009, s17, Registrar of Companies); NGO registration with the NGO Directorate to receive foreign funds; 2024 NPO Bill pending
cost_time: Fees ~USD 25-90 (SZL 500-2,000); official processing times unpublished; realistically 4-12 weeks; foreigners may register, but receiving foreign funds needs extra NGO Directorate registration

entity_types: Non-profit company (Companies Act 2011 s.15); Society (Societies Act 1966, am. 2001); Trust (Trusts Act); Co-operative (Co-operative Societies Act 6 of 2000)
cost_time: ~USD 30-40 (name reservation LSL 30 + incorporation fee LSL 500); official time unpublished, typically 1-4 months; no foreign-founder bar found

entity_types: Non-profit company (NPC, Companies Act 71/2008); trust (Trust Property Control Act 57/1988); NPO (NPO Act 60/1997); PBO tax status (Income Tax Act s.30, SARS)
cost_time: CIPC fee R175 (~USD 10) + R50 name reservation; no residency bar, foreign founders may register with certified passports; up to 25 working days; PBO ruling 3-12 months, official time unpublished

entity_types: Eingetragener Verein e.V. (BGB §§55-79); Gemeinnützige gGmbH (GmbHG §5); Private foundation (Stiftung, state law, BGB §§80-90); charitable (gemeinnützig) tax status (AO §§51-68)
cost_time: e.V.: court ~USD 70 + notary USD 200-500; gGmbH: capital USD 27,500 + notary/registry USD 700-1,200; Stiftung: endowment USD 27.5k-110k; registration 4-8 weeks; charity status timing unpublished

entity_types: Eingetragener Verein (Verein, Vereinsgesetz 2002/VerG); Private foundation (Privatstiftung, state-level Stiftungslandesgesetz); non-profit GmbH (GmbHG, charity tax status per EStG §7)
cost_time: Verein fee ~EUR 21-65 (USD 25-75), agent EUR 500-1,500 extra; 4-6 weeks; foundation: EUR 70,000+ endowment, several months; no residency rule, Austrian address needed

entity_types: Stiftung (foundation, PGR 2013 Stiftungsgesetz); Verein (association, PGR Art. 1031 ff.); Anstalt (foundation-like, PGR Art. 55 ff.)
cost_time: Endowment CHF 30,000 (~USD 33,000); registration up to CHF 700 (USD 770), Verein CHF 100; local trustee/agent fees extra (mandatory local officer); time unpublished

entity_types: Fondation/institution of public utility (Loi n°56 of 1922, sovereign decree); Association (Loi n°1355 of 2008, declaration); patrimonial foundation (bill 268, EUR 30k-100k)
cost_time: Foundation: no fee published; ~USD 55,000 (EUR 50,000) min endowment + lawyer; association declaration free. Foundation 3-12 months, association weeks; local office & administrators required

entity_types: Fondazione (foundation, Law 1 July 2015 n.101; dedicated private-foundation law in 2025 draft); Associazione (association, CGeG Registro delle Associazioni)
cost_time: ~USD 1,100-3,300 total (notary + registration + Italian docs); official time unpublished; 1-3 months, in-person, local registered office; no English service, most foreigners use an Italian association

entity_types: Združenie (NGO, Act 85/1985 Coll.); nadácia (foundation, Act 34/2002, endowment EUR 6,638); VPO public-benefit status (Act 65/2018, Ministry of Interior)
cost_time: Court fee EUR 220 (~USD 235); notary EUR 500-1,500 extra; ~USD 250-2,000 total; 1-2 months; VPO recognition time unpublished; foreign founders OK, Slovak charter + local address needed

entity_types: Udruženje (association, 3+ founders, NGO Law SL CG 39/11, arts 10-13); Fondacija (foundation, 1 founder, same law arts 25-27)
cost_time: Free registration (no fee per official registry); notary for founding docs ~USD 100-300 extra; 30-day statutory deadline, 1-2 months realistic; association needs 1 founder resident in Montenegro

entity_types: Association (udruženje) and foundation (fundacija) under Law on Associations and Foundations (OG 52/10, am. 239/2022); association: 5+ founders, 3 local residents; foundation: 1+ foreign founder
cost_time: Nominal state registration fee (unpublished; ~USD 0-50) plus notary/agent extras; Central Register decides within 5 days of complete application; end-to-end ~2-6 weeks incl. document prep
